description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifying various asynchronous methods for setting and getting state.

classes.name: ISimpleGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for simple operations with integer state management.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of A asynchronously.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of B asynchronously.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Calculates and returns the product of A and B asynchronously; with overload accepting parameters.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Retrieves the value of A asynchronously.
